description: A glass-fronted annex grafted onto the flank of the KSAB tower, its holo-marquee stuttering WRITERS' WING • SCRIPT LOCKED 04:00 in tired violet. Through the tint you can see the story floor's whiteboards standing in rows like headstones, and one desk lamp burning at an hour when nothing should be burning. A speaker nobody can find murmurs the network's own feed back at itself.
name: KSAB Writers' Wing
